bic_trace_step.reason: This commit is the fix for the vulnerability. It moves the hook registration (via `nft_register_flowtable_net_hooks` in `nf_tables_newflowtable` and `nf_tables_register_hook` in `nf_tables_addchain`) to be the very last step of the addition process. This ensures that if any error occurs prior to hook registration, no packets can be walking over the flowtable/chain, eliminating the need to unregister hooks and wait for an RCU grace period in the error path.
